description: Source code for the xemit.c file, part of the LibXDiff library, implementing diff emission functions such as emitting diff hunks and records, handling context lines, and integrating function name context if enabled.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_record(xdfile_t * xdf,long ri,char const * pre,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Emits a diff record for a specific line in the xdiff file, calling the user callback with the record's content and prefix.

methods.name: long saturating_add(long a,long b)
methods.description: Performs addition of two longs with saturation at LONG_MAX to prevent overflow.

methods.name: xdchange_t * xdl_get_hunk(xdchange_t ** xscr,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg)
methods.description: Identifies the latest change within the specified configuration to be included in a diff hunk, considering context length and ignoring distant changes.

methods.name: long def_ff(const char * rec,long len,char * buf,long sz)
methods.description: Default function to identify function names in source code lines, used for context tracking.

methods.name: long match_func_rec(xdfile_t * xdf,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,long ri,char * buf,long sz)
methods.description: Matches function record lines based on user-defined or default matching function.

methods.name: int is_func_rec(xdfile_t * xdf,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,long ri)
methods.description: Checks whether a record corresponds to a function definition based on matching logic.

methods.name: long get_func_line(xdfenv_t * xe,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,struct func_line * func_line,long start,long limit)
methods.description: Retrieves the line number of a function definition using a search from start to limit.

methods.name: int is_empty_rec(xdfile_t * xdf,long ri)
methods.description: Determines if a record (line) is empty or contains only whitespace.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_diff(xdfenv_t * xe,xdchange_t * xscr,xdemitcb_t * ecb,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg)
methods.description: Main function to emit a formatted diff for a set of changes, handling context lines, function name context, and emitting hunks with correct prefixes.
